description_en: Queries the carrier information of a phone number, including the province, city, basic carrier (China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom, or China Broadnet), mobile virtual network operator (such as Alibaba Cloud Communication), whether the number has been ported, and the number segment
description_zh: 查询手机号码的归属信息，包括：所属省份、所属城市、所属基础运营商（中国移动、中国联通、中国电信、中国广电）、移动转售企业（阿里通信等）、是否携号转网、归属号码段等
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi describe-phone-number-operator-attribute --input-number 13900001234 --auth-code Dd1r0004id --mask MD5 --flow-name - --result-count - --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePhoneNumberOperatorAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The phone number that you want to query.

- If Mask is set to NORMAL, this field is an 11-digit phone number.
- If Mask is set to MD5, this field is a 32-character encrypted string.
- If Mask is set to SHA256, this field is a 64-character encrypted string.
- If Mask is set to SM3, this field is a 64-character encrypted string.

><notice>The letters in the encrypted string are not case-sensitive.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的号码。

- 若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为11位手机号码。
- 若Mask取值为MD5，该字段为32位加密字符串。
- 若Mask取值为SHA256，该字段为64位加密字符串。
- 若Mask取值为SM3，该字段为64位加密字符串。

><notice>加密字符串中字母不区分大小写。</notice>
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

> On the **My Applications** page of the [Cell Phone Number Service console](https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

> 在[号码百科控制台](https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)**我的申请**页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method of the phone number. Valid values:

- **NORMAL**: no encryption
- **MD5**: MD5 encryption
- **SHA256**: SHA256 encryption
- **SM3**: SM3 encryption

><notice>All letters in the string must be uppercase.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
号码的加密方式。取值：

- **NORMAL**：不加密
- **MD5**：MD5加密
- **SHA256**：SHA256加密
- **SM3**：SM3加密

><notice>字符串中所有字母必须大写。</notice>
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en: A system parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: flow_name

parameters.help_en: A system parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: result_count
